paraphrase.proposes: This track delivers 550 packages for levels 5-9: 154 workbook lessons and 396 bank articles for the 11 books, with media, tags, and coverage reports. Commit c26e3bc9 amends the grouping tasks 1.G1 to 1.G5: it extends dashboard/scripts/plan-dedup.ts with level, target, printed, output, and path-display options, it fixes every error case, and it keeps the levels 1-4 output byte-identical. Task 1.G3 makes a provisional grouping of the old level 5-9 articles from a passages inventory, after the PM's go, with the targets 50, 100, 100, 150, and 150 as a provisional default. The output has no delete column and no absolute path, and Daniel decides the final level total and each kept article's fate. No deletion runs before Phase 7.
paraphrase.current_system: Today dashboard/scripts/plan-dedup.ts reads one inventory file and the fixed printed file docs/content-plans/data/legacy-levels-1-4-2026-10-02.json. It groups the online articles of each level by the cosine of a word bag (title 3, summary 2, passage 1) with average-link clustering, down to the level target minus the printed count. It keeps the best article of each group by student use, then approval, then date. It writes two fixed files under docs/content-plans/ with paths resolved against REPO_ROOT, and its markdown names data/duplicates-levels-1-4.json. The module runs main at import, so an import prints the usage text.
